title: phyllanthus antillanus var. virens
intro: Phyllanthus antillanus var. virens, commonly known as West Indian gooseberry, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phyllanthus antillanus var. virens include its ability to act as a hepatoprotective agent, reducing liver damage and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antiviral and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds such as corilagin and ellagic acid, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
